usedFor: Kylas CRM captures new leads, and Google Meet gets a call booked through “Schedule a Meeting” after “New Lead Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Kylas CRM, then “Schedule a Meeting” in Google Meet
bestTemplate.why: A fresh lead gets a meeting on the calendar straight away, so the first call is not left to memory.

watchOut: “Schedule a Meeting” creates a calendar event with a Meet link, so check the calendar and invitees you set.
